messages:
Iris: dropping a quick mock for the batch vectors toolbar — thinking we should re-evaluate action order. link: https://figma.redwood/batch-vectors/preview :eyes:
Jon: looks good visually. Question: why is Export the left-most action? users often hit it by muscle memory and we risk big exports accidentally
Priya: agree. Our analytics show export clicks spike when people are in preview mode. Maybe make Preview the primary action and move Export to overflow
Ethan: dev note: Export triggers a heavy job. If it's clicked accidentally we get queued tasks and it affects other tenant throughput. We can add a confirm modal but better to reduce surface area
Nora (PM): timeline: can we ship the simpler change (swap primary action) for the release candidate? confirm modal could be follow-up
Iris: proposal: 1) Primary: Preview/Run (solid) 2) Secondary: Save selection (outline) 3) Overflow: Export + Export all + CSV options. Also show an estimated file size before exporting
Jon: accessibility nits: - keyboard order currently tabs into Export first. That needs to follow visual priority. - Offscreen text should announce the estimated rows/MB before confirm. Add `aria-describedby` on the export button
Priya: copy suggestions: 'Export vectors' -> 'Export selected vectors (.csv)'. In the export modal show a sample header and row count. e.g. ```id,vector_0,vector_1,...,metadata```
Ethan: backend can return an approximate bytes value quickly from the worker before we enqueue. We'll surface it like "~2.1 MB (approx)" and then the confirm button says "Export (~2.1 MB)"
Iris: also thinking about preventing accidental multi-row selection when using shift+click. Maybe add a small toast: "You selected 1,200 rows — exporting may take several minutes" with a cancel link
Nora (PM): cross-team ask: ux + eng + infra agree on job priority behavior? we don't want exports to crowd out interactive preview traffic
Ethan: yep. I'll work with infra to ensure export jobs are low priority by default and can be batched. Will add progress events for the UI to subscribe to
Jon: screen reader flow: when the export modal opens, focus should go to the first interactive control and the SR announcement should read the sample header and the approximate size. Also ensure modal close returns focus to the toolbar button
Priya: small visual tweak: the relevance chips in the preview table need a non-color indicator (icon or label) for colorblind users. maybe a tiny dot with aria-label 'relevance: high/medium/low' and an additional text tooltip for sighted users
Iris: I'll update the Figma frames: - toolbar reorder - export in overflow - file-size badge - sample CSV snippet - SR announcements. Will include keyboard-only flows and both modal variants (confirm vs inline overflow action)
Nora (PM): great. Can we also include copy for the export toast and email notification ("Your export is ready: Download CSV")? we need consistent language across channels
Priya: draft copy: "Your vectors export is ready. Click to download or view in Exports page." For the modal: header "Export selected vectors" and CTA "Export (~2.1 MB)"
Ethan: will implement backend hooks for progress + download link. ETA: PR by end of sprint if UI changes are small
ui-bot: accessibility-checker: contrast warning on primary blue at 12px; recommend updating to meet AA at small sizes
Jon: noted. Iris, adjust color or increase padding font size for the primary button in the mock so contrast passes
Iris: will do. I'll tag everyone when frames are updated and upload a tiny screencast of keyboard flows :slightly_smiling_face:
Nora (PM): thanks team — consensus: make Preview primary, move Export to overflow, add filesize estimate and sample header, fix keyboard/focus order, and add SR announcements. Follow-up: confirm modal and job-priority controls in next cycle
Iris: closing the thread here
